dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: Tradition dictates that those who're in good health must help their neighbors once they're done with their own work.

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: Uncle Luo, the village elder, arranges our shifts. Several of us are in the south, and several more in the north, so we're always prepared.

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: If anyone needs help, they only have to talk to us.
